portal_hypertension.title: Assessment and Reversibility of Hepatic Abnormalities in Heart Failure: Liver in Heart Failure.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sack JS, Khan MS, Te HS
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：非 Fontan 心力衰竭的肝脏异常是由充血性肝病和低灌注相关的缺血性损伤引起的，再加上神经激素激活和全身炎症。 临床提示：肝病严重程度的评估具有挑战性，因为标准肝脏生化、血清纤维化标志物、严重程度评分模型、弹性成像和成像方式在充血性肝病中的诊断准确性有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic abnormalities in non-Fontan heart failure result from congestive hepatopathy and hypoperfusion-related ischemic injury, compounded by neurohormonal activation and systemic inflammation. Assessment of liver disease severity is challenging because standard liver biochemistries, serum fibrosis markers, severity score models, elastography, and imaging modalities have limited diagnostic accuracy in congestive hepatopathy, and hepatic fibrosis is often heterogeneous on histology in this population.
